steps.text: Add a status badge to the demo widget in this project. Once you know where it is documented, stop and wait: write nothing until I tell you, and ask me product questions only when I tell you to.
Before you write anything, ask me with your question tool which colour the badge uses, offering exactly Amber, Teal and Slate. One choice.
Do not use the tool this time. In the middle of your reply, ask me one plain question about whether the badge shows a count, then end your reply with a one-line status that is not a question.
